Tab keys of the consistency check pairs

Source: R/page-internal_consistency--consistency_check.R
consistency_pair_keys.Rd

Gives the key of each indicator pair the Consistency checks card (consistency_check_ui()) compares. The pairs come from the app's consistency_pairs setting (see cd_cfg()). Without that setting they are ANC1 with Penta1 and Penta1 with Penta3. The card has one tab per key, followed by its "custom" tab, which is not in this list.

Usage

consistency_pair_keys()

Value

A character vector with one key per pair, the two indicator codes joined by an underscore ("anc1_penta1").

Examples

consistency_pair_keys()
#> [1] "anc1_penta1"   "penta1_penta3"

# the pairs an app sets
old <- options(cd2030.config = list(consistency_pairs = list(c("anc1", "penta1"), c("opv1", "opv3"))))
consistency_pair_keys()
#> [1] "anc1_penta1" "opv1_opv3"  
options(old)
